captions.detailed: This 3D model is a long, narrow, U-shaped channel support designed to snap onto a cylindrical rod or valve stem. The main body is a rectangular bar with an open top channel running its entire length. At each end of the channel, there are circular cutout notches with narrow entry slots, creating a semi-flexible clip mechanism to snap-fit securely onto a stem.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric snap-on gate valve stem support in OpenSCAD. The script should allow the user to adjust the stem diameter, the overall support length, and the wall thickness, creating a U-shaped channel with circular snap-fit clips at both ends.
captions.factory: The design starts with a solid rectangular base using a 'cube' primitive. A smaller rectangular 'cube' is subtracted to form the main U-channel along the length. To create the cylindrical clip ends, two 'cylinder' primitives are rotated 90 degrees on the Y-axis and subtracted from the ends, positioned specifically using 'translate' to form the snap-fit openings.
